name: herdr-suspender
description: Herdr App mod: put Claude Code and Codex sessions to sleep to free their memory, resume them in the same tab, and restore them after a reboot
author: fakie-dev

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-layout.ts
scripts.build:check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .build-check && node scripts/compare-build.ts .build-check mods/suspender && node scripts/build-layout.ts --check
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "test/**/*.test.ts" && pnpm run build:check && pnpm run privacy
